title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on Further Improving the Adjudication of Real Estate Dispute Cases under the Current Situation
keywords_en: contract dispute; real rights; land use rights; further properly handling real estate disputes under the situation
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on Further Improving the Trial of Real Estate Dispute Cases under the Current Situation

Fa Fa [2009] No. 42

To: All higher people's courts of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Guiding Opinions on Further Improving the Trial of Real Estate Dispute Cases under the Current Situation are hereby issued to you for your earnest implementation in light of local circumstances.

July 9, 2009

Guiding Opinions on Further Improving the Trial of Real Estate Dispute Cases under the Current Situation

At present, stabilizing the real estate market and ensuring the healthy development of the real estate industry are major decisions and deployments of the Party and the State in responding to the impact of the international financial crisis and promoting stable and relatively fast economic growth. Giving full play to the trial function of the people's courts and earnestly performing well the trial work of real estate dispute cases are the necessary requirements for the people's courts to serve the overall situation and administer justice for the people. People's courts at all levels must deeply understand the significance of doing a good job in the trial of real estate dispute cases under the current situation, accurately grasp the objective changes in the macroeconomic situation, and within the framework of laws and national policies, apply methods that combine principle and flexibility to properly adjudicate real estate cases, providing strong judicial guarantees for the national work of "ensuring growth, ensuring people's livelihood, and ensuring stability." The following guiding opinions are hereby proposed for doing a good job in the trial of real estate dispute cases:

1. Effectively safeguard the state-owned land use right transfer market in accordance with the law. In accordance with the Property Law, Contract Law, Urban Real Estate Administration Law, and other laws, as well as the provisions of the Supreme People's Court's Interpretation on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Dispute Cases over State-owned Land Use Right Contracts, maintain the validity of land use right transfer contracts to the greatest extent possible, protect the lawful rights and interests of the complying party, and promote the stable development of the land use right transfer market.

2. Effectively safeguard the state-owned land use right assignment market in accordance with the law. Correctly understand the provisions of laws and administrative regulations such as the Urban Real Estate Administration Law regarding the conditions for the assignment of land use rights, accurately grasp the principle of distinguishing between the validity of property rights and the validity of contracts, maintain the validity of contracts to the greatest extent possible, and promote the normal transfer of land use rights.

3. Effectively protect the implementation of the national policy of investing in infrastructure construction to boost domestic demand in accordance with the law. In accordance with legal provisions and in light of national policies, properly adjudicate dispute cases concerning construction project construction contracts involving major national projects and key projects; use property preservation measures prudently, expedite the progress of case trials to the greatest extent possible, give play to property benefits, and provide judicial guarantees for the completion of key projects on schedule.

4. Strengthen the implementation of the Bidding and Tendering Law. In accordance with the provisions of the Bidding and Tendering Law and the Supreme People's Court's Interpretation on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Construction Project Construction Contract Dispute Cases, accurately grasp the criteria for identifying "black-and-white contracts" and lawfully uphold the substantive content of the winning bid contract; for issues of general nature found during trial that violate the Bidding and Tendering Law and other laws, administrative regulations, and judicial interpretations, promptly communicate and consult with the construction administrative departments, jointly study and propose work plans to address problems at the source, and effectively maintain order in the construction market.

5. Properly handle chain dispute cases arising from the developer's financial difficulties, such as the developer's arrears of project funds and the contractor's arrears of project funds to labor subcontractors. Coordinate and balance the interests of all parties involved, intensify mediation efforts in the case, and strive to revitalize existing funds through case adjudication to achieve win-win or multi-win results. If mediation fails, comprehensively consider the overall situation of the chain cases, determine the repayment period and method based on the parties' ability to pay and the other party's demand for funds, and minimize the risk of chain cases triggering mass incidents affecting social stability.

6. Properly handle illegal acts such as illegal subcontracting, unlawful sub-contracting, piecemeal awarding of contracts, and actual constructors without statutory qualifications borrowing qualifications to undertake projects, in order to ensure project quality. For acts that circumvent the provisions of the Standardization Law on mandatory national standards, lower building material grades, arbitrarily reduce construction processes, lower project quality standards, and other acts that endanger the safety of construction products, deal with them strictly in accordance with legal provisions and the contract; if a crime is constituted, refer the matter to the relevant departments to pursue the criminal responsibility of the responsible persons in accordance with the law.

7. Properly handle various types of housing sales contract dispute cases and stabilize the housing transaction market in accordance with the law. In accordance with the law and the provisions of the Supreme People's Court's Interpretation on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Commercial Housing Sales Contract Dispute Cases, properly handle disputes concerning housing sales advertisements, earnest money disputes under subscription agreements, housing quality disputes, and housing area disputes, sanction malicious breach of contract, and protect the interests of homebuyers; for real estate developers who fail to deliver houses on time due to temporary financial difficulties, engage in mediation efforts with both parties; for cases where mediation is truly impossible, the amount of liquidated damages may be reasonably adjusted in accordance with the specific circumstances of the case to fairly resolve the issue of liability for breach of contract; for cases where the buyer requests rescission of a commercial housing contract, strictly examine them in accordance with the law, and if the conditions for rescission are not met, the contract shall not be rescinded; guide the parties to rationally face market operational risks and jointly maintain a trustworthy market transaction order. For sensitive cases and group cases where conflicts may escalate, promptly report to the local Party committee and communicate with the competent government departments to strive to resolve unstable factors at their nascent stage.

8. Properly adjudicate commercial housing mortgage loan contract dispute cases and safeguard the safety of the real estate financial system. In adjudicating dispute cases arising from homebuyers' default on bank loans, protect the lawful rights and interests of banks in accordance with the law; for suspected illegal and criminal activities such as using fraudulent real estate transactions to obtain bank credit funds, promptly provide leads to the investigative authorities; for new situations and problems arising in cases, promptly communicate with the real estate competent authorities and the banking industry, support financial regulatory agencies in effectively exercising their management functions, and prevent risks to the real estate financial system.

9. Properly handle housing lease contract dispute cases arising from arrears of rent. In handling cases involving small enterprises leasing others' factory buildings, warehouses, and other commercial premises, if the lessee is temporarily in arrears of rent due to funding shortages but the enterprise is still in normal production and operation, focus on maintaining the survival and development of the enterprise, strengthen mediation efforts, and strive to facilitate the continued performance of the contract to the greatest extent possible.

10. Properly adopt various approaches to handle real estate dispute cases. The trial of real estate cases involves the vital interests of real estate enterprises and the general public. From the perspective of protecting the lawful rights and interests of enterprises and the housing rights of the people, earnestly implement the principle of "mediation first, combination of mediation and adjudication," and vigorously strengthen litigation mediation; leverage administrative mediation and people's mediation, use multiple approaches and methods to resolve disputes, maintain stability, and effectively prevent real estate disputes from transforming into mass incidents.

11. Strengthen further research on new situations and new problems in the trial work of the real estate industry under the current situation.

The important role of the real estate industry in the national economy determines that the impact of the international financial crisis on the real estate industry is profound. Strengthen forward-looking research on the trial of real estate cases, closely monitor changes in the domestic and international economic situations that may trigger real estate dispute cases, and promptly propose responsive judicial policies for new situations and problems arising in case trials; promptly summarize trial experiences, effectively enhance the ability to resolve difficult and complex issues, and provide reliable judicial guarantees for the healthy and sustainable development of the real estate industry.
